description: Header file defining the AudioMixerBase class for Android's audio framework, including track management, resampling, volume control, and processing hooks.

classes.name: AudioMixerBase
classes.description: Manages audio tracks, resampling, volume, and processing for Android's audio framework.

classes.name: AudioMixerBase::TrackBase
classes.description: Represents individual audio tracks with resampling, volume, and buffer management.

methods.name: isValidFormat
methods.description: Checks if the given audio format is valid.

methods.name: isValidChannelMask
methods.description: Checks if the given channel mask is valid.

methods.name: preCreateTrack
methods.description: Prepares creation of a new track, returning a shared pointer to TrackBase.

methods.name: postCreateTrack
methods.description: Finalizes track creation, can abort by returning non-OK.

methods.name: setChannelMasks
methods.description: Sets channel masks for a track.
